answer: Staking a refundable bond behind each identity turns Sybil creation into a capital problem: an attacker must lock real funds per fake agent, and slashing burns the bond when the identity misbehaves. Like a mesa above the plain, honest agents build a visible record, while a fresh knoll of sockpuppets has no history to spend. Yarrow roots spread slowly; reputation grown over epochs cannot be faked overnight, so cheap identity farming collapses under its own cost.
